text: Shows every sum and a year-by-year table, so the near tie and the 5.1-year break-even are fully explained, for one mileage only.
a2ui: Side-by-side cards with formatted totals and a bound year table read well; the sliders are honest about needing an agent round trip because the client cannot multiply.
html: Two crossing cost lines with a moving break-even marker and a shaded ownership window make the tie obvious, and both sliders recompute everything instantly.
agui: Typed, range-checked assumptions are exactly what a recalculation tool call needs, but the cost table is disabled number inputs and there is no chart.
